install.title: How to install a pack
install.step1_text: Open the pack's product page and click "Get download" there — the link takes you to the original source.
install.step2_title: Move it to the right folder
install.step2_text: Most language and texture packs go into the assetpacks folder of your Allumeria install — on Windows/Steam usually: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Allumeria Demo\assetpacks.
install.step3_text: Open the resource pack settings and enable it. Done — enjoy exploring!
install.note: If a pack comes with its own instructions, always follow those instead of this quick guide.

submit.title: Submit your pack
submit.intro: Made a language, texture, mod, or other pack for Allumeria? Fill in the details below — the button opens a pre-filled GitHub issue for us to review and add to the catalog.
submit.description_short_placeholder: One sentence, shown on the catalog card.
submit.description_long_placeholder: What makes your pack special? Shown on the product page.
submit.tags_hint: Tags always stay in English — a fixed taxonomy shared across the whole catalog.
submit.creator_label: Original asset creator (if different from you)
submit.image_logo_hint: Only a direct link to an image — no file upload, so no executable files can be smuggled in.
submit.license_label: I confirm I own the rights to this content or am authorized to publish it, and that it doesn't violate any applicable law.
submit.note: This opens a new tab with a pre-filled GitHub issue. A GitHub account is only needed to submit it — not to fill out the form.
submit.alt_link: Prefer to fill out the form directly on GitHub?
